crossrefs.text: For the gospel reveals the righteousness of God that comes by faith from start to finish, just as it is written: “The righteous will live by faith.”
Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”
You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.
Go now, write it on a tablet in their presence and inscribe it on a scroll; it will be for the days to come, a witness forever and ever.

because I, the LORD, will speak whatever word I speak, and it will be fulfilled without delay. For in your days, O rebellious house, I will speak a message and bring it to pass, declares the Lord GOD.’”
Now it is clear that no one is justified before God by the law, because, “The righteous will live by faith.”

notes.title: The righteous will live by faith

crossrefs.text: They will neither harm nor destroy on all My holy mountain, for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the LORD as the sea is full of water.
All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.
All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.
And on that day living water will flow out from Jerusalem, half of it toward the Eastern Sea and the other half toward the Western Sea, in summer and winter alike.
On that day the LORD will become King over all the earth—the LORD alone, and His name alone.
And they were calling out to one another: “Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of Hosts; all the earth is full of His glory.”
May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
Be silent before the LORD, all people, for He has roused Himself from His holy dwelling.”
Be silent in the presence of the Lord GOD, for the Day of the LORD is near. Indeed, the LORD has prepared a sacrifice; He has consecrated His guests.
“Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.
In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and exalted; and the train of His robe filled the temple.
As my life was fading away, I remembered the LORD. My prayer went up to You, to Your holy temple.
From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still
when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah
